title: Semantic Paint Ownership and Gameplay Runtime Restoration
changes: Restricted machine-local World Paint atlas ownership to the dedicated Paint tab so semantic Tiles/Map edits cannot be visually overridden by stale water bindings.
Restored the character-vitals runtime module registration lost during the cumulative terrain lane.
Restored authoritative left-click hotbar use with stamina costs and basic hoe, watering, scythe, fishing, tool, and hand actions.
Restored Shift sprint speed/drain, standing and interior recovery, rested recovery, fatigue-capacity loss and repair, and stationary interior rest.
Connected sprint speed to the existing modular LPC walk-cycle cadence while preserving authored idle/walk layers.
Forced regeneration of the reviewed LPC nature atlas, corrected the berry-bush atlas slot, and promoted wildflower/flower source candidates for the wild-plant runtime slot.
